professional_profile.long_bio:
I'm Rahul Kumar, a final-year Bio-Medical Engineering student at NIT Raipur (graduating June 2026) who transitioned fully into software engineering through self-study and intense project work. My technical foundation spans the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem — React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL — and extends deep into AI engineering territory.

My AI engineering work includes building a multi-provider LLM gateway (AI Gateway) that routes requests across 11 providers with automatic failover, error classification, and vision-aware routing. I built DriveClone, a full MERN Google Drive clone with a native MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the drive directly. I've worked with Stable Diffusion for AI-generated profile pictures using Docker, Redis, and BullMQ for async inference processing.

During my SDE internship at Bluestock Fintech, I shipped three production projects end-to-end: Logic Looper (a daily puzzle platform with 10 puzzle types, Redux state management, and seed-driven deterministic generation), an AI Profile Picture Maker, and The Corporate Blog. I owned the full delivery lifecycle from architecture decisions to deployment.

On the competitive programming side, I've solved 500+ DSA problems, reached a LeetCode rating of 1,746, scored 99.41 percentile in Naukri Young Turks 2025, ranked 242 in NCAT 2026, and was shortlisted for Round 2 of the Polaris Fellowship.

I'm also active in campus leadership — serving as Sponsorship & Outreach Lead for NIT Raipur's Innovation Cell and Technical Events Coordinator for the Robotics Club, where I co-organized a national hackathon with 200+ participants.

I'm seeking SDE-1, Full-Stack Engineer, or AI Engineer roles at Indian product companies, AI-first startups, and funded companies in Bengaluru and other major hubs.

Redux state management (game state + user state)

Redux slices for game state (gameSlice.js) and user state (userSlice.js)

flagship_projects.name: AI Gateway
flagship_projects.tagline: Multi-provider LLM gateway with automatic failover
flagship_projects.description: A TypeScript gateway that routes requests across 11 LLM providers with automatic failover, error classification, and vision-aware provider filtering. Persists conversation context in SQLite so a failover mid-chat doesn't lose history. Ships a React dashboard for watching provider health and request logs live. Containerized with Docker and covered with Jest tests.
flagship_projects.problem: LLM applications dependent on a single provider face downtime, rate limits, and capability gaps. No unified interface exists for routing across multiple providers with intelligent failover.
flagship_projects.solution: A TypeScript gateway with provider abstraction layer, error classification engine, failover decision engine, vision-aware routing, SQLite conversation persistence, and React monitoring dashboard
features: Multi-provider support — routes requests across 11+ LLM providers
Automatic failover — seamlessly switches providers on failure
Error classification — categorizes errors (rate limit, auth, timeout, etc.)
Vision-aware routing — automatically filters providers based on vision capability needs
Provider health monitoring — tracks provider health and response times
React dashboard — real-time provider health visualization, request/response log viewer, conversation history browser, provider configuration management
architecture: Provider abstraction layer with base class (base.ts) and per-provider implementations
SQLite database layer for conversation persistence
Express.js API server with structured routes
api_endpoints: POST /api/chat — Send message with automatic failover
technical_decisions: SQLite for conversation persistence — lightweight, no external database required
Provider abstraction with base class — consistent interface for all providers
Error classification before failover — intelligent routing based on error type
Vision-aware filtering — prevents routing vision requests to text-only providers
flagship_projects.interview_value: highest — strongest AI-infra project with real failover/error-classification logic, not just a wrapper around one API. Demonstrates system design thinking.
resume_bullets: Built an AI Gateway routing requests across 11 LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) with automatic failover, error classification, and vision-aware provider filtering
Implemented SQLite-based conversation persistence ensuring failover mid-chat preserves context, with a React dashboard for real-time provider health monitoring
Containerized with Docker, covered with Jest tests, and structured with TypeScript provider abstraction layer
